title: Adipurush
desc: The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Sinam
desc: A police sub-inspector investigates the sudden disappearance of his beloved wife. When he finds out what happened to her, he sets out to exact revenge against the culprit.

title: The Mummy
desc: Rick and his group accidentally awaken a mummy during an archaeological excavation.

title: Mahavatar Narsimha
desc: Hiranyakashyap, a demon, challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

title: Jumanji: The Next Level
desc: After Spencer goes missing, his team of confidantes comes back to Jumanji to go to the undiscovered regions and support him in escaping the world's most lethal game.
Jackson Curtis, a discontented writer, battles against all odds to keep his family secure when a series of apocalyptic calamities threaten to decimate humankind.

title: CJ7
desc: Ti, a poor construction worker, struggles to provide basic education to his son Dicky. He finds an orb in the scrapyard and mistakes it for a toy. It turns out to be an alien with regenerative powers.
